question: List the names of the buildings with the most floors. If there are ties, list each one separately.
statements: CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "fclt_floor" AS SELECT "fclt_building_key" AS "fclt_building_key", "floor" AS "floor" FROM beaver."fclt_floor";
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "fclt_building" AS SELECT "fclt_building_key" AS "fclt_building_key", "building_name_long" AS "building_name_long" FROM beaver."fclt_building";

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
WITH counts AS (
    SELECT f.fclt_building_key,
           COUNT(DISTINCT f.floor) AS floor_count
    FROM fclt_floor f
    GROUP BY f.fclt_building_key
), maxc AS (
    SELECT MAX(floor_count) AS max_floor_count FROM counts
)
SELECT b.building_name_long AS building_name,
       c.floor_count
FROM counts c
JOIN maxc m ON c.floor_count = m.max_floor_count
JOIN fclt_building b ON b.fclt_building_key = c.fclt_building_key
ORDER BY building_name
